visualCharacteristics.purpose: Shadowed white panel with a title, arrow link list and stacked CTA buttons
visualCharacteristics.layout: Single panel; standalone or adopted as the aside column of a preceding cards block
notable: Links in the list get arrow icons
Bold links become stacked primary buttons

contentPattern.structure: One cell with a heading, a bulleted list of links, and CTA paragraphs with bold links

usage: Use for a compact box of related links and calls to action, typically beside a cards grid
reuseGuidance: Fits a short titled list of navigation links plus a few CTAs; not for images or long text
